checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: show the current star pace in the moves HUD so every move tells the player whether three stars are still reachable

impact_assessment.why: The HUD shows moves against par but not the rating those moves would earn. A player who overshoots par by one only discovers the lost 3-star run on the victory card; starsFor already defines the boundary at par and par+2.
impact_assessment.benefits: Three small stars next to the move count dim as the run crosses par and par+2, giving immediate, glanceable feedback without a new panel or modal; the aria label states the pace for screen readers.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: adds a data-cue marker and reuses starsMarkup; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: derived from moves and par, reset with the session; layout: the moves metric grows by about 30px and may wrap at 320px.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Static HUD marker test, starsFor boundaries already covered, before/after HUD screenshots at moves 0/5/8 on Double Down, a real five- and eight-click run reading the star count and aria label, mobile width checks, and the 18-level regression.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented: hud-stars cue in the moves metric, starsMarkup(starsFor()) and pace aria label in updateGameView, compact star row styling, HUD contract assertion, README and ADR-016
[3/3] Verified: npm test 87/87; aikit check 5/5; Double Down moves 0/5/8 show 3/2/1 earned stars and matching aria labels; no horizontal overflow at 320-414px; 18/18 levels at par; checklists: passed
Task 'cycle-08-star-pace' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: distinguish earned and unearned stars by shape, not only color, so forced-colors and color-impaired players can read the pace

impact_assessment.why: In forced-colors mode the HUD renders all three stars with the same glyph and computed color rgb(0,0,0), even though earned is [true,true,false]; the same filled glyph is used for both states everywhere. The star pace added in cycle 8 is therefore unreadable in Windows High Contrast and weak for color-impaired users.
impact_assessment.benefits: Earned stars stay filled and unearned stars become outlined, so every star row in the HUD, chamber index and victory card carries its state without color; forced-colors screenshots become unambiguous.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: star markup moves to a pure module and unearned glyphs change; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no score change; layout: the outline glyph is the same width in the supporting fonts.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure starsMarkup/starLabel tests for 0/2/3 stars, forced-colors and normal-mode HUD screenshots at the same Double Down moves-5 state, a real click run reading filled/outline counts, a reduced-motion audit, and the 18-level regression.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented: pure stars.js with filled/outlined glyphs and labels, app imports it, four star-markup tests, README and ADR-017; reduced-motion audit found the existing 1ms guard already correct

[3/3] Verified: npm test 91/91; aikit check 5/5; forced-colors HUD reads filled-filled-outline with all black; normal mode keeps gold filled plus grey outline; reduce mode collapses beam animation to 0.001s; 18/18 levels at par; checklists: passed
Task 'cycle-09-star-shape' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: add a one-shot ring burst on a receiver the moment a rotation first charges it

impact_assessment.why: Charging a receiver now plays the two-note cue and starts the persistent pulse, but the visual state change is only a border/glow swap; there is no transient impact at the exact moment the beam connects. Split Decision at moves 1 has one lit receiver and no burst class or ring.
impact_assessment.benefits: The charge event gets a brief expanding cyan ring that confirms the connection at the cell, reinforcing the audio cue and the star-pace change without altering the persistent lit state.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: updateBoard gains an optional previous-lit set and a new is-charging class; dependency: none; concurrency: rapid rotations can retrigger a receiver, so per-node timers must cancel cleanly; state: derived from the trace, no save change; reduced motion collapses the animation.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure newlyLitKeys cases, per-node WeakMap timers with reflow restart, a real Split Decision click captured 120ms after the charge before/after, a class removed check after 700ms, forced-colors border mapping, and the 18-level regression.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented: newlyLitKeys helper with two tests, previous-lit updateBoard path, per-node WeakMap burst timers, clear-on-reset, white 600ms charge-burst ring, forced-colors border, README and ADR-018

[3/3] Verified: npm test 93/93; aikit check 5/5; real Split Decision charge shows one is-charging receiver and charge-burst at 120ms, clears by 820ms, and reset during the burst clears at once; 18/18 levels at par; checklists: passed
Task 'cycle-10-charge-burst' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: teach the fixed prism in the in-game mechanic note on prism-only chambers

impact_assessment.why: Split Decision and The Vault contain fixed prisms, but their mechanic note is hidden; only the legend says 'Prism splits light' and the detailed three-way behavior lives in the how-to modal. Splitter and portal chambers get an in-game note, so the first prism mechanic is the only Episode I mechanic without one.
impact_assessment.benefits: Players meet the prism's pass-through plus two perpendicular forks in the side panel on the chambers that introduce it, without lengthening the combo chambers that already show splitter and portal notes.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: mechanics copy moves into a pure module; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: derived from parsed board pieces; layout: one extra note box on prism-only levels, which still fits 1440x900.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure mechanicNotes cases for prism-only, splitter, portal, combo and plain boards, before/after side-panel screenshots on Split Decision, a played 2-click clear, a combo-level unchanged check and the 18-level regression.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented: pure mechanicNotes module with six tests, app renders the notes, prism-only chambers get the pass-through/fan lesson, combo and splitter/portal copy unchanged, README and ADR-019

[3/3] Verified: npm test 99/99; aikit check 5/5; Split Decision and The Vault show the Prism note, Double Down/Wormhole/Confluence unchanged, Split Decision clears in 2 clicks/3 stars; 18/18 levels at par; checklists: passed
Task 'cycle-11-prism-note' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: pin modal actions below a scrolling content area so the primary button is reachable without scrolling on phones

impact_assessment.why: At 390x844 the Field Manual dialog is 760px tall, its whole content scrolls, and the primary action sits at y=832 with a 876px bottom; the button is below the fold and the probe reports primaryVisible false. Desktop keeps it visible, so the how-to action only fails on phones.
impact_assessment.benefits: How-to, pause and victory actions stay in view while the body scrolls; the primary button is tappable immediately and the close button stays at the top. Desktop layout keeps the same content and actions.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: modal actions move outside .modal__content and the dialog becomes a flex column when open; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no save change; layout: content scrolls instead of the whole dialog, and small screens keep full-width buttons.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Structural UI test, 390x844 and 1440x900 before/after probes with modal/content/action rects, a real tap on the primary action, a content-scroll check that the actions stay fixed, and the 18-level regression.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented: modal actions moved outside the scrolling content, flex-column open dialog, content overflow, pinned action row with rule and solid glass, compact mobile padding, modal-structure test, README and ADR-020

[3/3] Verified: npm test 100/100; aikit check 5/5; 390x844 primary visible at y733-777, content scrolls 673/765, actions fixed after scroll, real tap returns to game; desktop content 658/658; 18/18 levels at par; checklists: passed
